title: Zeta Global Stock: Buy, Hold, or Sell in October 2026?
creator: Parkevtate Vosianc CFA
source_note: Detailed summary generated from video captions; auto-captions garble names/numbers in places
summary: Parkevtate Vosianc asks whether Zeta Global is a buying opportunity in October 2026 and answers yes, reiterating a BUY he says he has held all year (ranking updated 9 Oct 2026, previously 7 Aug 2026). The growth record is the core of the case: revenue has risen roughly fivefold, from about $300 million on a trailing basis in 2021 to $1.57 billion, while cash flow from operations to sales has more than doubled from about 7% to 15.3%, making the business self-funding and able to raise capital from strength rather than desperation. Research and development has fallen to 9.36% of revenue even as AI improves the product — one example he cites is custom application build time dropping from about a week to minutes. On valuation the stock is not cheap: at $33.54 it trades at 28x forward earnings, in the middle of its recent range, and his discounted cash flow fair value is $33.70, essentially the market price, after a rise of more than 65% year to date. His reason to buy anyway is that free-cash-flow estimates keep being revised higher as the business outperforms. He gives no specific bear case; the summary is based on the captions analysis recorded in the 15:00 run on 2026-10-13. Call made: ZETA BUY at $33.54 (DCF $33.70), medium conviction, no flip.
